# AIVA — AI Visibility Audit

> AIVA scores how well a business shows up when buyers ask AI assistants
> (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini) for recommendations — and tells the
> business exactly what to fix. Think of it as the AI-search counterpart to
> an SEO audit: SEO gets you ranked, AIVA tells you whether you get
> *recommended*.

AIVA is a self-serve SaaS for small and medium businesses, marketing leads,
and agencies. It runs real buyer-intent prompts against AI assistants,
records how each one answers, and produces two scores:

- **AI Visibility Score** — whether AI assistants surface and recommend the
  business when buyers ask the questions that lead to a purchase.
- **Site Readiness Score** — whether the business's website is technically
  legible to AI crawlers (robots.txt access, structured data, llms.txt,
  content clarity).

Each paid report includes a competitor comparison, a plain-English
"AI Positioning Brief," and a prioritized 30/60/90-day fix plan with
copy-paste code snippets. Reports refresh monthly so businesses can track
movement over time.

## Facts

- Product name: AIVA (AI Visibility Audit)
- Category: AI visibility / answer-engine optimization (AEO) auditing
- Audience: small and medium businesses, marketing teams, agencies
- Free tier: one free sample per email and per website
- Paid tier: monthly subscription with full report, competitor analysis,
  and monthly automated rescans
- Assistants tested: ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini
